item.title: Top 5 Steps to Secure JWT Authentication in Blazor with .NET 8
item.description:
In this comprehensive guide, we’ll explore how to implement secure JWT authentication in your Blazor application using .NET 8. Managing user sessions and ensuring secure communication between your Blazor front-end and API is crucial. This guide will walk you through step-by-step how to set up JWT authentication, store tokens securely, and protect your application from common security risks.
